Get VTB Infobasket Roster

Source: R/vtb.R
vtb_infobasket_roster.Rd

A club's player roster in one season.

Endpoint: GET https://org.infobasket.su/Widget/TeamRoster/{team_id}

Usage

vtb_infobasket_roster(team_id, season, lang = "en", tag = "vtb")

Arguments

team_id

Infobasket TeamID (team_id in the calendar, a box score or the v2 matches), e.g. 2650 (Lokomotiv Kuban).

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025-26); the wrapper maps it to the season-level Infobasket CompID with vtb_infobasket_seasons (one extra request per tag, cached). Required.

lang

Label language (en or ru). Most bodies carry both languages whatever is asked; the leader categories' labels follow it.

tag

Competition tag scoping the profile: vtb (VTB United League, default), vtbyouth, wbc, wpremier or rfb. The season table is read for this tag.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: A club's player roster in one season. The columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py vtb_infobasket_roster); an empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data, a valid body with no rows for this frame is a zero-row tibble:

col_nametypedescription
team_idintegerInfobasket TeamID (2650 = Lokomotiv Kuban); the v2 teamId. Not a club-record id and not a registration id.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26): the season the request asked for, stamped by the runtime.
person_idintegerInfobasket person id (PersonID): one person (player, coach or official) across clubs and seasons. Joins to /Widget/PlayerPage/{personId} (players) and /Widget/CoachPage/{personId} (coaches).
player_numberintegerShirt number as an integer (-1 when none).
display_numbercharacterShirt number as displayed ('0' and '00' differ).
is_captainlogical1 for the team captain, else 0.
birth_datecharacterBirth date (ISO 8601 date) of a player: public bio, kept; coaches' and officials' birth data is never output.
pos_idintegerPosition code: players 1 point guard, 2 shooting guard, 3 small forward, 4 power forward, 5 centre; coaches 1000 head coach, 1001 assistant; officials 101-103 referees, 104 commissioner, 111-123 table officials (exact roles unverified).
positioncharacterPlaying position: a record (PlayerPage) or its English name (TeamRoster).
nationality_codecharacterNationality, ISO 3166 alpha-2.
country_codecharacterNationality, ISO 3166 alpha-2.
country_code_ioccharacterNationality code: ISO 3166 alpha-2 in most rows ('RU', 'US'), IOC alpha-3 in some ('BLR').
country_namecharacterNationality, English country name.
rankintegerUnobserved: the roster sends an empty string for every player and coach (null here); the field belongs to the leader lists (best_players), so its meaning on the roster is unconfirmed.
heightintegerHeight in centimetres.
weightintegerWeight in kilograms.
is_activelogicalTrue while the person is on the current roster.
active_statuscharacterRoster status text ('Accepted'), empty otherwise.
person_last_name_rucharacterLast name, Russian.
person_last_name_encharacterLast name, English.
person_first_name_rucharacterFirst name, Russian.
person_first_name_encharacterFirst name, English.
person_full_name_rucharacterFull name, 'Last First', Russian.
person_full_name_encharacterFull name, 'Last First', English.
person_genderintegerPerson gender: 1 on every sampled (male) person.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in vtb_infobasket_seasons().
